 Singh and Landau advise on Singapore haze probe
 3 min read
 | 
 06 November 2026 
 | 
 Jessica Seah 
 Jessica Seah 
 Davinder Singh SC and Toby Landau KC
 The Singapore government has appointed Davinder Singh SC to advise it on the conduct of a probe into corporate responsibility for a toxic haze that has engulfed the city-state and its neighbours, while adding Toby Landau KC to a panel of experts that will support the inquiry.
